items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: Now they talk about a good sax man. That's Zach Valley Dufour.

ctx.x: Yeah, but this is before, this is before Bud Friedman became very popular, I guess. Before Odd Castle. Oh, yeah. So even Wayne King played sax on those days, something like that.

Um... Valley Dufour. Oh, yeah. If I could think, if I want to get a chance to think of it like that, you know, it takes time. Yeah. It's so long, you know what I mean? Yeah. Now they talk about a good sax man. That's Zach Valley Dufour. He's a good clarinetist too, I've heard of. That's how I'm going to play clarinetist. Oh, yeah. You've got to end right of you. What was the place you wanted to ask about Dick's on the... Well, the Honeysuckle Inn? I always wondered why they called it the Honeysuckle Inn. That was…
